Davido’s aide, Damilare Aladegbola, popularly known as Dre, has appealed to the person who allegedly stole his phone during rapper Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai’s wedding ceremony to return it. The aide took to his Instagram on Monday, promising to reward whoever took the phone with money in exchange for its return. “If na u carry my phone for Zlatan wedding, abeg return am, I go give you money please,” he wrote in pidgin English. He further said, “From now on, if I go any party or dey any party and any stupid waitress tell me say are you done eating so I can pack your plate, na swear I go swear for you cause na pattern. Wey una dey use pack phone for table be that now.” PUNCH Online reports that Zlatan ties the knot with his longtime partner, Davita. Davido, K1, others grace Zlatan’s traditional wedding Evening recap: Shoprite plans comeback, Tinubu-Atiku clash over hunger, other stories PHOTOS: Zlatan, Davita shine in regal attire for traditional wedding The music star posted the wedding pictures on his official Instagram page ahead of their traditional wedding ceremony, which is being held on Saturday. He wrote, “IT’s TIME TO MARRY” Celebrities, fans, and well-wishers were at the wedding ceremony in Lagos, with Davido leading the pack of groomsmen at the event.
